title: Add files or folders to an existing Zip archive
summary: You can add new files or directories to an existing .zip archive without recreating it. Use the recursive flag if you are adding a directory.

steps.explain: Run the zip command with the existing archive name and the files or directories you want to add. Add the -r flag to include directories recursively.

placeholders.description: Paths to files or directories to add
